document: Native reload bootstrap and same-session recovery19
status: Linux helper and joined checks pass; current Mac recovery and new Swift behavior unverified

observation.source: User screenshot and report after accidental native reload
observation.visible: JavaScript exception; static origin-aware heading and blank editors

cause: Fragment bootstrap was consumed and URL scrubbed; reload threw before mounting editors.
changes: Per-document native bootstrap injection without web storage credentials
Protected native reload gate via existing prepareClose and context release
Same-session reopen using original bundled client/app and separate report
Archive setup pointers on future fresh builder runs
Clear bootstrap failure message and explicit protected-work notice

verification.negative: Fragment-only reload throws while committed revision remains unchanged
verification.positive: Injected reload restores saved state; protected drafts survive explicit restore; failed protection blocks helper handoff
verification.reopen: Inspect-only original bundled client preserves identities/revision; missing store and identity mismatch refused
limits: Actual native reopen not executed on Linux
Chromium helper does not prove WKNavigationDelegate interception
Already lost unprotected memory cannot be reconstructed

next: Keep old app open; separate terminal native:joined:reopen, not native:joined. Check saved text before rebuilding; avoid reload in original reused binary.
scope: Foundation experiment/docs only; no architecture or native acceptance inferred.
